messages:
maria: quick orbit check — where are we on the throughput milestone for this sprint? specifically kernel microbatch changes and KV cache eviction tuning. any blockers?
ajay: KV eviction changes are on staging but perf baseline showed CPU spikes during burst tests. need a kernel microbatch test pass. pinging @kevin for the latest kernel branch.
kevin: pushed an alternative microbatch scheduler (PR #4821) that changes batching heuristics. there's a runtime flag `--microbatch-v2` and a fallback in case of regressions. can someone run a canary load with it?
sophie: I can run the canary today. do you want perf-runner or the kprobe harness?
maria: perf-runner (kitchen) is fine — see runbook: https://confluence/redwood/perf-runbook. target is to validate p99 and token/sec. aiming for a rollout window Wed 09:00 UTC if canary is green.
ajay: one dependency note — dedupe-cache schema migration from platform team must land first; otherwise eviction changes will mis-handle old segments. @ryan any ETA on migration?
ryan: migration staged for Tue 00:00 UTC (low-traffic window). should be quick but I'll watch for any schema incompatibilities. will call it out if anything blocks.
infra-bot: deploy scheduled: canary environment will receive `microbatch-v2` at 2026-06-10T18:00Z. Please confirm test owners. :gear:
kevin: miscellaneous: I reduced default `max_batch_delay` from 12ms -> 8ms in the branch to favor latency. this may reduce batching efficiency — we'll measure token throughput and cost delta alongside latency gains.
sophie: noted. I'll capture p50/p95/p99 + token/sec + cost-per-token from console (per-route breakdown). will attach short chart in this thread after the run.
maria: clarifying ownership for the rollout: kernel microbatch = kevin (lead), KV cache tuning = ajay (lead), monitoring & staged rollout = sophie (lead). I'll update the sprint board and our milestone checklist.
ajay: quick ask: kv eviction PR #4799 needs at least 1 more reviewer before merge. @kevin @sophie can you take a look tomorrow morning?
kevin: on it — I'll do an initial pass by EOD today.
sophie: review queued, will leave comments and tests requests.
maria: final policy for rollout: if canary shows >5% regression in p99 or >8% drop in token/sec, abort and rollback immediately. otherwise we'll ramp 20% -> 50% -> 100% over ~2 hours. command to run the canary: ```deploy --env=canary --flag=microbatch-v2 --traffic=20%```
maria: tagging closes — updates here after canary run. :thumbsup:
